[[File:Coruscant_subway.png|thumb|Entrance to a subway station on Coruscant in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].]]

The '''Coruscant subway''' was a system of underground railways on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CW24" />

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and some [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] chased [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[Roron Corobb/Legends|Roron Corobb]], and [[Foul Moudama]] through the subways in an attempt to kidnap the Supreme Chancellor. The ensuing pursuit damaged the subway's automated turnstile, a window, and possibly a train when a MagnaGuard droid was thrown in front of it. After the Jedi destroyed the MagnaGuards, Shaak Ti managed to defeat Grievous by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to tie his cape to a train and activate it, whisking the general away.<ref name="CW24" />

Shortly after the pursuit, the Jedi and Palpatine met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], who boarded a train to get to Palpatine's bunker. On the way there, Grievous, along with several battle droids reappeared and attacked the Jedi, forcing Windu to duel the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] on top of the train.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

At this time, entrance to the subway cost each passenger two [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CW24" />
